enriched_activities.desc: Lie down on the bed on the right side. Pull the blanket over the body. Pull the blanket up to the shoulders. Move the right arm under the pillow. Bend the legs. Turn over onto the left side. Adjust the pillow with the left hand. Keep the fan running at the bedside. Turn the head to the other side. Pull the blanket down to the chest. Stretch both arms out. Remain lying still with eyes closed. Breathe steadily. Turn onto the back. Place both hands on the blanket. Stay asleep until 06:15.

enriched_activities.activity: Washing face, brushing teeth, and taking a morning shower
enriched_activities.desc: Hear the alarm and reach out the right hand to the phone on the nightstand. Tap the screen to stop the alarm. Sit up on the bed. Swing both legs off the bed. Stand up. Walk to the bathroom. Open the bathroom door. Turn on the light. Turn on the water heater. Turn on the tap. Wet both hands. Pick up the facial cleanser. Squeeze cleanser onto the left palm. Rub both palms together. Apply the cleanser to the face. Rinse the face with water. Pick up the towel. Wipe the face dry. Pick up the toothbrush. Squeeze toothpaste onto the bristles. Brush the teeth. Rinse the mouth with water. Spit into the sink. Turn off the tap. Step into the shower area. Turn on the shower. Wet the hair and body. Pick up the shampoo bottle. Pour shampoo into the palm. Rub it into the hair. Rinse the hair. Pick up the soap. Rub the soap over the body. Rinse the body. Turn off the shower. Pick up the towel. Dry the hair. Dry the body. Step out of the shower. Turn off the water heater. Turn off the light. Open the door. Walk out of the bathroom.

enriched_activities.activity: Boiling the kettle, preparing and eating breakfast
enriched_activities.desc: Walk into the kitchen. Turn on the light. Open the cabinet door. Take out the kettle. Fill the kettle with water at the tap. Close the lid. Place the kettle on its base. Press the switch to start boiling. Open the refrigerator door. Take out the eggs and a pack of bread. Close the refrigerator door. Place the eggs and bread on the counter. Open the cabinet. Take out a plate and a bowl. Place the plate and bowl on the counter. Crack two eggs into the bowl. Pick up a fork. Beat the eggs with the fork. Turn on the induction cooker. Place the frying pan on the induction cooker. Pour oil into the pan. Pour the beaten eggs into the pan. Stir the eggs with a spatula. Turn off the induction cooker. Slide the eggs onto the plate. Put two slices of bread on the plate. Pick up the kettle. Pour hot water into a mug. Put a tea bag into the mug. Carry the plate and mug to the table. Sit down on the chair. Pick up the fork. Eat the eggs and bread. Pick up the mug. Drink the tea. Stand up. Carry the plate and mug to the sink. Rinse the plate and mug under the tap. Place them in the drying rack. Wipe the counter with a cloth.

enriched_activities.activity: Sitting on the sofa reading news and checking messages on phone
enriched_activities.desc: Walk from the kitchen to the living room. Sit down on the sofa. Pick up the phone from the pocket. Unlock the screen with the thumb. Tap the news app icon. Scroll down through the headlines. Tap one article. Read it. Swipe back to the list. Tap a second article. Scroll to the bottom. Swipe back to the home screen. Tap the messaging app icon. Open the first message thread. Read the messages. Type a reply on the on-screen keyboard. Tap send. Open the second message thread. Read it. Type a short reply. Tap send. Tap the calendar icon. Check the day's appointments. Swipe through the week view. Tap back to today. Place the phone on the sofa armrest. Pick up the TV remote from the coffee table. Press the power button. Watch the screen for a few minutes. Press the volume button. Put the remote down on the coffee table. Pick up the phone again. Check the weather page. Lock the screen. Put the phone into the pocket. Stand up from the sofa.

enriched_activities.activity: Setting up the home workspace with computer and desk lamp, reviewing emails and planning the day's program tasks
enriched_activities.desc: Walk into Bedroom 1. Pull out the chair. Sit down at the desk. Open the laptop lid. Press the power button. Pick up the desk lamp plug. Plug it into the wall socket. Press the lamp switch to turn it on. Adjust the lamp arm toward the keyboard. Move the mouse pad to the right side. Place the mouse on the pad. Open the email application. Scroll through the inbox. Click the first email. Read it. Click the reply button. Type a short reply. Click send. Click the next email. Read it. Mark it as read. Open the task management document. Type the day's task list. Add a line for the activity schedule. Add a line for the funding notes. Add a line for volunteer emails. Open the calendar application. Add a video call entry for the morning. Set the time. Save the entry. Pick up the phone. Check the messages. Put the phone down on the desk. Save the task document. Lean back in the chair.

enriched_activities.activity: Working from home on community program coordination: drafting activity schedules, writing funding notes, and joining video calls
enriched_activities.desc: Place both hands on the keyboard. Type the headings of the activity schedule. Open the template file with the mouse. Copy the table. Paste it into the new document. Edit the date of each session. Edit the time of each session. Type the name of each activity. Save the file. Open the funding notes document. Type the first paragraph. Type the budget figures. Check the totals with the calculator application. Correct one figure. Save the file. Open the video call link in the browser. Put on the headset. Unmute the microphone. Say 'Good morning, everyone, can you hear me?' Listen to the replies. Say 'I will share the schedule now.' Click the share screen button. Scroll through the schedule on the screen. Say 'The first event is on the fifteenth.' Answer a question from a colleague. Say 'I will send the updated file after the call.' Click the stop share button. Mute the microphone. Leave the call. Take off the headset. Open the volunteer email list. Type a message to the volunteers. Attach the schedule file. Click send. Save all open documents.

enriched_activities.activity: Heating up and eating lunch, making a hot drink
enriched_activities.desc: Stand up from the desk chair. Walk to the kitchen. Open the refrigerator door. Take out the lunch container. Close the refrigerator door. Open the microwave door. Place the container inside. Close the microwave door. Press the timer buttons. Press the start button. Wait next to the counter. Hear the beep. Open the microwave door. Take out the container. Close the microwave door. Carry the container to the table. Sit down on the chair. Open the lid of the container. Pick up the fork. Eat the lunch. Drink water from a glass. Stand up. Put the container in the sink. Rinse the container. Place it in the drying rack. Pick up the kettle. Fill the kettle with water. Place the kettle on its base. Press the switch to boil. Take a mug from the cabinet. Put a tea bag into the mug. Pour hot water into the mug. Stir with a spoon. Carry the mug to the table. Sit down. Drink the tea. Stand up. Rinse the mug. Place the mug in the drying rack. Wipe the table with a cloth.

enriched_activities.activity: Taking a short afternoon walk around the neighborhood to get some fresh air
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to the entryway. Pick up the keys from the hook. Put the keys into the jacket pocket. Open the front door. Step outside. Close the door behind. Walk down the steps. Turn left at the gate. Walk along the sidewalk. Pass the first street corner. Cross the road at the crossing. Continue along the block. Turn right at the second corner. Walk past the small park. Stop at the park entrance for a moment. Turn around. Walk back along the same street. Cross the road again. Walk up to the building entrance. Open the front door. Walk up the stairs. Open the apartment door. Close the door. Take the keys out of the pocket. Hang the keys back on the hook. Take off the shoes. Place them on the shoe rack.

enriched_activities.activity: Continuing work from home: emailing volunteers, updating program documents, and preparing materials for upcoming community events
enriched_activities.desc: Walk into Bedroom 1. Sit down at the desk. Wake the laptop screen. Open the email application. Click the compose button. Type the volunteer's name in the address field. Type the subject line. Type the message body. Attach the schedule file. Click send. Open the next email in the inbox. Read it. Click reply. Type an answer about the event date. Click send. Open the program document. Scroll to the participant list. Add three new names. Update the contact details. Save the document. Open the materials folder. Open the poster file. Edit the event title. Edit the location line. Export the file as a PDF. Open the printing settings. Select two copies. Close the print window. Open the inventory spreadsheet. Type the number of chairs needed. Type the number of tables needed. Save the spreadsheet. Pick up the phone. Check a message from the venue contact. Type a reply. Put the phone down. Close the laptop lid. Stand up from the chair.

enriched_activities.activity: Cooking dinner using the induction cooker and oven
enriched_activities.desc: Walk into the kitchen. Turn on the light. Open the refrigerator door. Take out the vegetables and the meat. Close the refrigerator door. Place them on the counter. Open the drawer. Take out a knife and a cutting board. Place the cutting board on the counter. Pick up the knife. Cut the vegetables into pieces. Cut the meat into pieces. Say to Member 2 'Can you preheat the oven?' Open the cabinet. Take out a baking tray. Place the meat on the tray. Season the meat. Slide the tray into the oven. Press the oven dial to 200 degrees. Turn on the induction cooker. Place the pan on the induction cooker. Pour oil into the pan. Add the vegetables to the pan. Stir with a spatula. Add salt from the shaker. Stir again. Turn off the induction cooker. Pick up the plates from the cabinet. Place the plates on the counter. Slide the vegetables onto the plates. Open the oven door. Take out the tray with oven gloves. Close the oven door. Place the meat on the plates. Carry the plates to the table.

Pull out a chair. Sit down at the table. Pick up the fork. Eat the vegetables. Eat the meat. Say to Member 2 'This turned out well.' Pick up the glass. Drink water. Pick up the fork again. Continue eating. Pick up a napkin. Wipe the mouth. Put the fork down on the plate. Push the plate to the middle of the table. Lean back on the chair. Pick up the glass. Drink the rest of the water. Stand up from the chair. Pick up the plate and the glass.

enriched_activities.activity: Unwinding on the sofa and watching TV
enriched_activities.desc: Walk into the living room. Sit down on the sofa. Pick up the TV remote from the coffee table. Press the power button. Press the channel button. Watch the screen. Say to Member 2 'What do you want to watch?' Press the volume button. Put the remote down on the sofa cushion. Lean back against the backrest. Stretch both legs forward. Pick up the remote again. Change the channel. Watch the program. Put the remote on the coffee table. Pick up the phone from the pocket. Scroll through the phone. Lock the screen. Put the phone back into the pocket. Pick up the remote. Press the power button to turn off the TV. Stand up from the sofa.

enriched_activities.activity: Clearing the table, loading the dishwasher, and tidying the kitchen
enriched_activities.desc: Walk into the kitchen. Pick up the plates from the table. Carry them to the sink. Scrape the leftovers into the bin. Open the dishwasher door. Pull out the lower rack. Place the plates on the rack. Place the forks on the rack. Place the glasses on the upper rack. Push the rack back in. Add a detergent tablet to the dispenser. Close the dishwasher door. Press the start button. Pick up a cloth. Wipe the table. Wipe the counter. Say to Member 2 'I will wipe the stove as well.' Wipe the induction cooker surface with the cloth. Rinse the cloth under the tap. Wring the cloth out. Hang the cloth on the hook. Turn off the kitchen light. Walk out of the kitchen.

Walk into Bedroom 1. Sit down on the bed. Lean back against the headboard. Pick up the phone from the nightstand. Unlock the screen. Tap the social media app. Scroll through the feed. Tap one post. Read the comments. Swipe back. Tap the video app. Watch a short video. Swipe to the next video. Swipe again. Tap the back button. Open the messaging app. Read a group message. Type a short reply. Tap send. Scroll through the contacts list. Lock the screen. Put the phone down on the nightstand. Stretch both arms. Stand up from the bed.

enriched_activities.activity: Watching TV and playing video games on the game console
enriched_activities.desc: Walk into the living room. Sit down on the sofa. Pick up the game controller from the shelf. Press the power button on the game console. Pick up the TV remote. Press the power button. Press the input button to switch to the console channel. Pick up the controller with both hands. Press the start button. Select a game from the menu with the directional pad. Press the confirm button. Play the game. Press the buttons to move the character. Say to Member 1 'Wait, I missed that jump.' Pause the game with the menu button. Pick up the glass from the coffee table. Drink water. Put the glass down. Resume the game. Play for several rounds. Press the menu button to quit the game. Press the power button on the console. Press the power button on the TV remote to turn off the TV. Put the controller back on the shelf. Stand up from the sofa.

enriched_activities.activity: Taking an evening shower and getting ready for bed
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to the bathroom. Open the bathroom door. Turn on the light. Turn on the water heater. Step into the shower area. Turn on the shower. Wet the body. Pick up the soap. Rub the soap over the body. Rinse the body. Pick up the shampoo bottle. Pour shampoo into the palm. Rub it into the hair. Rinse the hair. Turn off the shower. Pick up the towel from the hook. Dry the hair. Dry the body. Wrap the towel around the head. Step out of the shower. Pick up the toothbrush. Squeeze toothpaste onto the bristles. Brush the teeth. Rinse the mouth. Spit into the sink. Turn off the tap. Wipe the face with the towel. Hang the towel on the hook. Turn off the water heater. Turn off the light. Open the door. Walk out of the bathroom.

enriched_activities.activity: Reading and browsing on phone before sleep, with the fan on
enriched_activities.desc: Walk into Bedroom 1. Sit down on the bed. Pick up the book from the nightstand. Open the book to the bookmark. Read two pages. Turn the page. Read another page. Close the book. Place the book back on the nightstand. Pick up the phone. Unlock the screen. Open the reading app. Scroll through the article list. Tap one article. Read the article. Scroll down. Scroll to the top. Tap the back button. Open the messaging app. Read a message from Member 2. Type a short reply. Tap send. Lock the screen. Put the phone down on the nightstand. Stand up. Walk to the fan. Press the fan button to turn it on. Press the speed button. Walk back to the bed. Pull the blanket down. Sit on the bed.

Lie down on the bed. Pull the blanket over the body. Place the head on the pillow. Turn onto the right side. Pull the blanket up to the shoulders. Bend the left arm under the pillow. Turn onto the left side. Adjust the pillow with the right hand. Stretch both legs. Turn onto the back. Place both hands on the blanket. Keep the fan running at the bedside. Close the eyes. Remain lying still. Breathe steadily. Stay asleep until 24:00.
